parties: Bharti Airtel Lanka (Pvt) Limited v. Biyagama Pradeshiya Sabha and Others Bharti Airtel Lanka (Pvt) Limited v. Biyagama Pradeshiya Sabha and Others View More
keywords: The Petitioner sought the intervention of this Court, challenging the order made by the 1st and/or 2nd Respondents, suspending the construction of the telecom base station despite having lawfully obtained the necessary approvals. Held - the decision of the Respondents was found to be politically influenced, issued without hearing the Petitioner, and in violation of the rules of natural justice. Writs issued.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
